page.layout: One printed page, framed by a decorative woodcut border. Running head at top centre with page number at top right; text in verse lines, a few right-aligned; catchword/signature line at foot ("D 2" centre, "um" right is a line-end fragment of the last verse line). No marginal notes on this page. Left edge shows the neighbouring page, not transcribed.

page.notes: Line-end fragments in the scan are partly obscured by the border; the printed lines are transcribed as legible. Show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
